wrong_extinguisher_banner: Wrong extinguisher! It won't work on this fire.
prompt_lesson: Tap the floor to begin the lesson
prompt_place_wall_content: Tap the floor to set up the fire safety station
prompt_place_fire: Tap the floor to start the fire
prompt_scan_wall: Move your phone slowly to scan the wall…
prompt_scan_floor: Move your phone slowly around so it can see the floor…
prompt_activate_alarm: Sound the alarm first — tap the call point on the wall
prompt_scanning_floor: Looking for a good spot for the fire…
guide_default: Pick the extinguisher that matches this fire
guide_class_a: Ordinary combustibles — wood, paper, cloth. Grab the GREY extinguisher
guide_class_bc: A liquid or electrical fire — grab the YELLOW extinguisher. Skip the grey one here, it won't help and it isn't safe
guide_class_abc: This one could spread across several materials — the RED extinguisher is your safest bet
pass_aim_base: Aim at the base of the fire, not the flames
pass_squeeze: Squeeze the handle to start spraying
pass_sweep: Sweep side to side as you spray
pass_keep_spraying: Keep going until the fire's completely out
wrong_extinguisher_warning_line: ⚠ That's not the right extinguisher for this fire — try another one
alarm_not_activated_warning_line: ⚠ Sound the alarm before you touch an extinguisher!
check_gas_shutoff: Shut off the gas supply before the fire is extinguished
check_extinguisher_class: Choose the correct extinguisher for this fire class
cert_enter_name_prompt: Enter your name and tap Generate.
cert_verify_invalid: ✗ INVALID — this text was not issued by this app, or has been altered.
scenario_trashcan: A fire just started in a trash can! What should you do?
scenario_outlet: A fire just started at an overloaded power outlet! What should you do?
scenario_cabinet: A fire just started in the electrical cabinet! What should you do?
scenario_furnace: A fire just started at the gas furnace! What should you do?
proximity_warning: Step back! Don't stand within 4 ft. of the fire.
